source.title: Element Puzzle (js13k 2014)
source.creator: SunTemple
source.source_mechanic: Collect fire, earth, water and air tokens to change the element's form; movement changes with the last token.

transformation.implementation: An original seeded rectangular maze with visible elemental tokens, form-matching seals, a marked exit, and a closed perception-action movement loop.
transformation.new_rules: Each luminous seal admits only the currently visible form. Token contact changes form immediately. Basalt, tide, zephyr, and ember are represented by visibly distinct original CSS-rendered materials.
transformation.assets: No source assets copied; all visuals are CSS, text, glyphs, and generated geometry.

license_notes: The benchmark implementation is an independent recreation of the surveyed generic mechanic and does not bundle the source game or its assets.
